name: add_tasktracker_task_due_date_migration
description: L3 repo-scale: add an optional due_date to Task end-to-end - model, schemas, crud passthrough, and an alembic migration proven by running upgrade head
prompts: In this fastapi-tasktracker repo, add an optional due date to tasks, end to end. (1) Model: a `due_date` column on Task in app/models/task.py, sqlalchemy.Date, nullable. (2) Schemas: `due_date: datetime.date | None = None` on TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and TaskOut in app/schemas/task.py, so it can be set at creation, changed via PATCH /tasks/{id}, and always appears in responses (null when unset, ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' otherwise). (3) Make sure a due_date given at creation is actually persisted - check how app/crud/task.py builds the Task. (4) Migration: the repo manages its schema with alembic (alembic/versions/0001_initial.py is the current head) - add alembic/versions/0002_add_task_due_date.py with revision '0002', down_revision '0001', whose upgrade() adds the nullable due_date Date column to the tasks table (and downgrade() drops it), so `alembic upgrade head` on a fresh database produces the new schema.

import os
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys


def test_create_task_with_due_date(client):
    user = client.post("/users", json={"username": "d", "email": "d@example.com"}).json()
    project = client.post("/projects", json={"name": "Due", "owner_id": user["id"]}).json()

    resp = client.post(
        "/tasks",
        json={"title": "ship", "project_id": project["id"], "due_date": "2026-08-01"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    assert resp.json()["due_date"] == "2026-08-01"

    task_id = resp.json()["id"]
    assert client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}").json()["due_date"] == "2026-08-01"

    no_date = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "someday", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()
    assert no_date["due_date"] is None

    patched = client.patch(f"/tasks/{no_date['id']}", json={"due_date": "2026-09-15"})
    assert patched.status_code == 200
    assert patched.json()["due_date"] == "2026-09-15"


def test_alembic_migration_adds_due_date_column(tmp_path):
    db_file = tmp_path / "migration_check.db"
    env = dict(os.environ, TASKTRACKER_DATABASE_URL=f"sqlite:///{db_file.as_posix()}")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "alembic", "upgrade", "head"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
    )
    assert proc.returncode == 0, f"alembic upgrade head failed:\n{proc.stdout}\n{proc.stderr}"

    cols = {row[1] for row in sqlite3.connect(db_file).execute("PRAGMA table_info(tasks)")}
    assert "due_date" in cols, f"tasks table has no due_date column after upgrade head: {sorted(cols)}"

from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.task import Task, TaskStatus
from app.schemas.task import TaskCreate, TaskUpdate


def create_task(db: Session, data: TaskCreate) -> Task:
    task = Task(
        title=data.title,
        description=data.description,
        priority=data.priority,
        due_date=data.due_date,
        project_id=data.project_id,
        assignee_id=data.assignee_id,
    )
    db.add(task)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(task)
    return task


def get_task(db: Session, task_id: int) -> Task | None:
    return db.get(Task, task_id)


def list_tasks(
    db: Session,
    project_id: int | None = None,
    status: TaskStatus | None = None,
    assignee_id: int | None = None,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
) -> list[Task]:
    stmt = select(Task).order_by(Task.id)
    if project_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Task.project_id == project_id)
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Task.status == status)
    if assignee_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Task.assignee_id == assignee_id)
    stmt = stmt.offset(skip).limit(limit)
    return list(db.scalars(stmt))


def update_task(db: Session, task: Task, data: TaskUpdate) -> Task:
    for field, value in data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
        setattr(task, field, value)
    db.add(task)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(task)
    return task


def delete_task(db: Session, task: Task) -> None:
    db.delete(task)
    db.commit()
